notes.title: Last Content Update + Now Supporting Korean and Traditional Chinese
notes.content:
[i]REYNATIS[/i] is a full-blown action-packed magical RPG in which two people with different perspectives fight for their ideals in a realistic recreation of modern-day Shibuya, Tokyo. The last free update is released now!

And the game now supports Korean and Traditional Chinese for the interface and subtitles.

[b]Chapter in Dream: Into the Dream[/b]
A dream once seen as "if = dream" begins to distort into a nightmare.

Only Marin holds the power to save those tormented by it—with a single word spoken in the dream. But when the dream transforms into a real battle against his greatest enemy, Marin is not alone.

Will you dare to step into the dream and rewrite destiny?

* The screenshot is from the Japanese version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/b683faddfcbc6ddfc0e5f53c2ae669afe8e7c3b9.jpg[/img]

[i]REYNATIS[/i] is a full-blown action-packed magical RPG in which two people with different perspectives fight for their ideals in a realistic recreation of modern-day Shibuya, Tokyo. The seventh free update just came in!

[b]Chapter 24 if: Ukai, Strategic Prodigy[/b]
Watching Moa receive the chalice from Makabe, Ukai feels complex emotions stirring in his heart.

These mixed feelings prompt Ukai to begin telling the story of events from his past.

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified and new Chapter 03 if: Squad Leader Dogo released!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that [i]REYNATIS[/i] has been officially Verified for Steam Deck!

[i]REYNATIS[/i] is a full-blown action-packed magical RPG in which two people with different perspectives fight for their ideals in a realistic recreation of modern-day Shibuya, Tokyo. The latest update introduces a new episode featuring Dogo, continuing the thrilling story in unexpected ways!

This update also includes the following fixes:[list]
[*] Added an option to choose framerate settings of 30, 60, or 120 FPS (default set to 60).
[*] Resolved an issue where certain keys could not be rebound in the keyboard settings.[/list]
[b]Chapter 03 if: Squad Leader Dogo[/b]
During the usual evening assembly, Dogo is called out by Dogami and promoted to lead the new Dogo Squad.

However, everything takes a dramatic turn when Dogo unexpectedly encounters a person who had caused problems at the security company where he used to work...

* The screenshot is from the Japanese version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/72e753a2115e7381d29727c838a09fc617cf4d28.jpg[/img]

[b]+ Wishlist[/b] today and stay tuned for upcoming news, including content updates!
* The content update schedule may be subject to change without notice.

notes.title: REYNATIS - Steam Version Features & Launch Discount
notes.content:
REYNATIS arrives on Steam, bringing exciting features that enhance your gameplay experience. Enjoy the beautiful visuals with 4K resolution and high frame rates. Whether you prefer keyboard and mouse control or gamepad, the game offers seamless compatibility. Customize your experience further with selected graphics options, ensuring the best performance on your PC. Plus, REYNATIS is playable on Steam Deck, giving you the freedom to take the action wherever you go.

Here are a few features of the PC version:

[h2]4K Resolution and High Frame Rate[/h2]
Experience REYNATIS in 4K resolution and smooth high frame rates up to 120fps. Enjoy every scene with enhanced clarity and precision.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/198a3829b00fe90151ef308fe3beb35636d1d9c9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/286c141fa0eab79be240088934fd8b3d978a6844.jpg[/img]

[h2]Keyboard and Mouse Control Support[/h2]
Customize your playstyle with full keyboard and mouse controls, offering greater flexibility and precision in combat and exploration.

[h2]Selected Graphics Options[/h2]
Tailor your visual experience with a variety of graphics settings, ensuring the game runs optimally on your hardware.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/3368c1523f9a6f670a7a97d9ed2507f5dd61f83c.png[/img]

[h2]Playable on Steam Deck[/h2]
Take your Shibuya action-packed experience on the go! REYNATIS is compatible with Steam Deck, delivering a smooth gaming experience wherever you are.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/c6fb99e6e23bb1412adf533dc34ec0d6a1d3b50c.jpg[/img]

And enjoy a special launch discount and exclusive bonuses until October 10!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/3edc689a08fd710065ca33357c2329d3826b3484.png[/img]

notes.title: Nine Free Updates Coming to REYNATIS
notes.content:
The action-packed RPG [i]REYNATIS[/i] will receive nine free updates, including new story episodes for main characters Marin Kirizumi and Sari Nishijima, along with a secret episode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899105/8d18d33f6550d4c990d726559e7e7cb877d20be8.png[/img]
Here are the 3 free updates that've been revealed:
- New story episode for Marin Kirizumi
- New story episode for Sari Nishijima
- An extra secret story episode!

Check out the screenshots below, hinting at more action, magical clashes, and additional story insights the updates will bring to highly-anticipated [i]REYNATIS[/i]. Stay tuned for further information on all planned content updates!
[i]* The actual implementation schedule of the content updates may be changed without notice.[/i]
